dedupe_keys.name: obsyd european power data aggregation and public api

description: OBSYD collects European power-market and grid series into a hosted desk and a versioned public API. Its documentation describes day-ahead prices, load, generation by fuel, installed capacity, outages, cross-border flows, forecasts and gas context for enabled bidding zones. The public API serves one zone and series over a chosen interval in JSON, CSV or Parquet, and exposes coverage and freshness endpoints; self-hosting uses the open-source code with source-provider API keys. The current site lists 38 configured European bidding zones, while the repository description says 37, so zone coverage should be read from the live registry at use time. Most hourly history is described as about five years, but depth and temporal resolution vary by series and zone. Code is AGPL-3.0 and hosted read-only access is free without an account; personalised features use a login. ENTSO-E, Elexon, GIE and Fraunhofer data retain their own terms. A modeller can prepare load and generation inputs or compare cross-border conditions, but live values and API completeness were not tested. It complements data-entsoe-transparency-platform through aggregation and coverage reporting.
